name: launch_chain
description: Remove the local psibase db directory, start psinode, wait for HTTP admin status, run psibase boot by default, then keep psinode running until it exits.

workspace_root.description: psibase repository root (contains db/). Defaults to (in order) explicit value, MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOTS, WORKSPACE_ROOT, CWD.

db_dir.description: Directory psinode uses for chain state. Defaults to <workspace_root>/db. Pass an explicit path when running parallel chains in one worktree, or to keep one chain isolated from another. The wipe step removes only this directory.

admin_ip.description: Value for PSIBASE_ADMIN_IP when starting psinode.

producer.description: Block producer name passed to psinode -p and psibase boot -p.

api_url.description: Full HTTP base URL passed to psibase boot -a (e.g. http://psibase.localhost:8080/). If omitted, defaults to http://{http_host}:{listen_port}/. Use a hostname that supports per-service subdomains (psibase boot constructs URLs like accounts.<host>); plain IPs like 127.0.0.1 will fail because accounts.127.0.0.1 is not a valid DNS name.

http_host.description: Host used with listen_port when api_url is omitted. Must support per-service subdomains for psibase boot (default psibase.localhost works because *.psibase.localhost resolves to 127.0.0.1).

psinode_path.description: Explicit psinode binary. Else PSIBASE_PSINODE, then build/psinode, then PATH.

psibase_path.description: Explicit psibase binary. Else PSIBASE_PSIBASE, then build/rust/release/psibase, then PATH.

skip_boot.description: If true, only start psinode after wipe; do not run psibase boot.

errors.description: psinode or psibase binary not found.
Admin status endpoint did not respond in time.
Another psinode job already holds the lock on db_dir. Use the holder PID/job_id surfaced in the result to investigate, or pass a distinct db_dir.

Pre-flight TCP bind on listen_port failed. Pass a distinct listen_port (and matching api_url / http_host) or stop the process currently holding the port. There is a small race between probe and psinode launch; if another process binds in between, psinode itself will report the same condition.
